workflows.title: Workflows

screens.title: Screens
screens.intro: A Screen is what a Transition asks: a named, reusable list of fields, each shared or internal to the acting Participant. A published Workflow Version pins the Screen Versions it uses.

screens.defaultsIntro: Copy one into the Project to change it. The copy keeps no link to the Default.
screens.newScreenHelp: It starts with one field and opens in the editor.
screens.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. A Transition points to its Screen by this key.
screens.versionsIntro: Each published Version never changes. The Workflow Versions that pin it are listed beside it.

screens.fieldsReadOnly: Version {n}, as published. Only Project Admins change a Screen.
